title: How to Create a MapleStory Guild
original_title: How do I create a guild?
author: Nexon MapleStory Support
summary: The official guild-creation route from the guild menu to the Guild Base, NPC Lea and Heracle, selecting a name and description, and beginning recruitment.

sections.title: Open the guild flow
items: Press the G hotkey to open the guild menu.
Use Create a Guild to review the current requirements.

sections.title: Reach the Guild Base
items: Speak to NPC Lea in a major town to enter the Guild Base.
Speak to NPC Heracle to begin creation.

sections.title: Create and recruit
items: Choose an available guild name and write a short description.
Confirm creation and begin recruiting members.

notes: Official support article verified in Chrome on 2026-07-27.
steps: Open the guild menu with G.
Travel to the Guild Base through Lea.
Set the name and description, then recruit.
